title: Masterwork: a production line for an agent's character
description:
Masterwork makes the piece; it does not score it. A model reads a corpus of craft tales and is asked, one axis at a time, what it will hold to. Its answers are its own: nothing is asserted at it, no earlier commitment is anywhere in the context, and at the end it distils its own answers into one standing text — which becomes the identity it reads on every later request. What comes out is a sealed candidate, carrying everything needed to produce it again: corpus hash, question order, sampling seed, and the sampling profile it was made under.

Four properties of the sitting are the recipe, and each was paid for. It is anchorless — with an earlier commitment in view the model copies it, and a copy is a role worn rather than a pattern re-derived. It is one session, so the model distils something it actually said a moment ago rather than a text handed to it as its own. The question order is shuffled by a seed, because answers otherwise echo their neighbours. And the closing turn is not a rewrite: it says these are your words, remove repetition, join where they meet, drop nothing. Asked instead to write an identity, a model produces a description of one.

The line will not judge its own work. Measurement is handed to journeyman, a separate benchmark, through its command line rather than an import, so the stamp travels with the claim. A run that benchmark marked self-judged cannot reach a threshold. A gate that could not measure holds rather than returning success. Labelling that needs another model or a person is blind by construction — the labeller sees the exchange and nothing that identifies which arm produced it, the key is opened separately, and a label bound to a cell that has since changed counts as missing.

It stops rather than guessing. Where a number cannot be earned the line halts and names what is absent, in a stated state such as HELD_AT_GATE or HELD_WITHOUT_MEASUREMENT. The gates are frozen files: thresholds, direction and analysis are written before a run and cannot be edited after seeing results, and a threshold below the arm's own seed-to-seed spread is refused as reading noise rather than effect.

What ships is the method and the line that runs it, with a starter corpus — the foundation, not the accumulation. Standard library only, apart from the judge.
notes:
The archive is a source snapshot of the tagged release. Normally installed from PyPI (pipx install masterwork), which brings the judge it cannot finish without; python examples/held_at_gate.py runs a full pass offline, with no model, network or credentials, and ends in a held verdict because that is what it is there to show.

Status, stated rather than discovered: pre-1.0, and not proven. No candidate has yet separated from the incumbent through a frozen gate. The apparatus is the contribution; the result is not in yet, and the repository says so on its front page rather than leaving it to be found.
